description: History of electricity demand in Québec is a dataset listed in Hydro-Québec open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Hydro-Québec. Ensemble de données historiques d’Hydro Québec sur la demande d’électricité au Québec en mégawatts. Les données sont disponibles à l’heure et cumulées annuellement. Elles montrent les variations du besoin d’électricité en fonction de l’heure de la journée. Coverage: Québec (Hydro-Québec). The portal files it under Electricity consumption. The portal shows 52,608 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-06-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY-NC 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-donnees-hydroquebec-com-portal.
